revision: S2/P3: schematic S2 (S1 + REC button SW1 on PC2 of both MCUs, REC LED D6 on U3 PC3). Placement P3 (user 2026-10-23): P2 + the REC button SW1 on F inside the vactrol U7 outline (U7 on B, the user solders the button from the other side) and the REC LED D6 in a row with it (Y84.7). P2: J10 horizontal at the bottom, AUDIO/CV jacks moved down, ENV LED centred above CUTOFF/DECAY, pot row pitch 24 mm. Routing (R1) starts from P3 on the native board.
frame: Panel frame: origin at the panel upper-left corner seen from the front, X across (right), Y down, mm. KiCad sheet position = kicad_origin + panel XY. The main PCB F side faces the panel, so the KiCad top view equals the front view (no mirroring).
rail_note: Doepfer single hole pair at X7.5 (HOLE_X0 in case/tools/build_case.py; the Bread Modular Panel_6HP has the same pair). Skiff rails as the MIDI module: clear Y8.0..120.5.

main_pcb.note: 29.0 x 110.0 mm as modules/low, held by the four jack nuts (RV09 pots take no nut). 1 mm edge keep-out (root AGENTS.md); ~89 SMD parts on B: 4 layers likely at routing (as modules/acid).

panel_order: Top to bottom (user brief 2026-10-23, P3): MIDI + NOISE IN; NOISE TONE + BLUE TONE; ENV LED (centre); CUTOFF + DECAY; REC button (left) and REC LED (right) in one row; AUDIO OUT + HAT CV OUT; power header (B) along the bottom edge.
row_note: Columns X7.75 / X22.25 (modules/low). F rows: jacks Y21 (courtyard Y14.72..28.83); pots Y41 (35.88..49.68); ENV LED X15 Y54.8 (52.57..57.03); pots Y65 (59.88..73.68), 10.2 mm courtyard gap between the pot rows; REC button X7.75 and REC LED X22.25 in one row at Y84.7 (button courtyard 80.9..88.5); out jacks Y102 (95.72..109.83). B: vactrol U7 under the REC button (76.75..92.65), J10 horizontal along the bottom (111.57..117.73).
pot_part: Song Huei R0904N 50k / 1M linear (user stock), vertical snap-in, tall shaft (L = 25 mm, knurled, no threaded bushing, no nut): the pot Bread Modular uses, on the Bread Modular Potentiometer_RV09 footprint
led_note: 3 mm THT on F at rotation 0 (pads side by side, anode pad 2 right), placed by the pad centre = body centre; dome flush with the panel front as modules/8bit. D5 (envelope / HAT CV) centred above CUTOFF + DECAY; D6 (REC, U3 PC3) in a row with the REC button (P3).

stack_Z_mm.note: As modules/8bit (LED dome flush with the 1.6 mm FR4 panel front).

vactrol_part: Chinese VTL5C-type vactrol, Bread Modular VTL5C footprint + modules/low courtyard, hand-soldered on B.

vactrols.note: Hi-hat VCA, vertical on B in the left column between CUTOFF (courtyard Y73.68) and AUDIO OUT (Y95.72): courtyard X1.59..12.41, Y76.75..92.65; pads at Y78.35 / 91.05. P3 (user 2026-10-23): the REC button SW1 sits on F inside this outline (pads X4.5/11.0, Y82.45/86.95, clear of the vactrol pads); the user solders it from the other side.

power_header.orientation: Horizontal along the bottom edge (user direction 2026-10-23), rot 270 on B as modules/vca-mix: odd pins on the upper row Y113.4, even pins on Y115.94; pins 1/2 (-12 V) at the left, pins 9/10 (+12 V) at the right. Courtyard Y111.61..117.73 (1 mm edge keep-out: board edge Y119.25).
power_header.idc_note: A 16-pin cable plugs on aligned at pin 1 (red stripe = -12 V, at the left); positions 11-16 overhang to the right, over the board, never past an edge. Envelope = 2x8 socket (25.4 x 6.4 mm body, 3.81 mm beyond the end pin centres) plus a 1.2 mm key bump on either side. No THT pad under it (out-jack sleeve pads end at Y109.53). B-side SMD placed under it later must stay <= 2 mm tall.

back_side_tht.note: bottom edge, horizontal, as modules/vca-mix power_header (rot 270 on B)
NOISE MCU (U2) UPDI: pin 1 UPDI Y30.0, pin 2 GND Y32.54, right edge between NOISE IN and BLUE TONE
HIHAT MCU (U3) UPDI: pin 1 UPDI Y30.0, pin 2 GND Y32.54, left edge between MIDI and NOISE TONE

smd_parking.note: Every SMD part waits here, off the board edge, in reference order; it moves onto the board with its functional group (root AGENTS.md divide and conquer).

button_note: Generic 6 x 6 mm THT tact (7 mm), stock SW_PUSH_6mm_H7.3mm on F, placed by the pad-pattern centre = stem centre, rot 180 (pad 1 signal on the bottom row) as modules/acid; pressed through the panel by the modules/8bit printed cap. P3: centred on the REC column X7.75 Y84.7, inside the vactrol U7 outline (U7 on B).
